items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01974-wPolitical identity is known to shape climate attitudes, but its effect on real-world adoption of clean technologies has been unclear. Now, data from Germany show that rising far-right support slows the uptake of rooftop solar and electric cars. However, these effects are not large enough to stall the transition.

items.title: Feedbacks between natural climate solutions and plant invasions
items.title_en: Feedbacks between natural climate solutions and plant invasions
items.title_zh: 自然气候解决方案与植物入侵之间的反馈作用
items.summary_en: Biological invasions and carbon sequestration guide many modern-day land management decisions. However, intersections between invasions and natural climate solutions (NCS)—actions to maintain or increase the land carbon sink—have not received adequate attention in either the invasion or climate mitigation literature. We therefore review how plant invasions affect NCS and vice versa, focusing on reductions in emissions and carbon removals associated with avoided habitat conversion, restoration, forest and cropland management, agroforestry, and optimal grazing. We find that plant invasions can interfere with rapid NCS implementation and reduce the durability of carbon storage in many systems, although there are cases in which invasive plants increase carbon storage, creating biodiversity-climate mitigation trade-offs. At the same time, studies find that several NCS increase community resistance/resilience to invasions, and do so in forests, in particular, which can suppress invasive species spread in these systems. These dynamics suggest a positive feedback loop between NCS and invasions, in which NCS facilitate invasion control, and successful invasion control, in turn, eases further NCS implementation. This feedback could accelerate gains in land-based carbon storage and generate co-benefits for biodiversity, provided that NCS projects receive resources for sustained invasive species management. We highlight areas in need of further research, including how financial mechanisms for climate action could be used to overcome invasion-induced implementation barriers.
items.summary_zh: 生物入侵和碳封存是当今许多土地管理决策的重要依据。然而，入侵与自然气候解决方案（NCS）——即旨在维持或增加土地碳汇的举措——之间的交集，无论是在入侵研究文献还是气候减缓文献中，都尚未得到充分关注。 因此，我们回顾了植物入侵如何影响自然气候解决方案，反之亦然，重点探讨了通过避免栖息地转化、生态修复、森林和农田管理、农林复合经营以及优化放牧所带来的减排和碳移除效应。 我们发现，尽管在某些情况下入侵植物会增加碳储量，从而产生生物多样性与气候减缓之间的权衡，但植物入侵可能会干扰自然气候解决方案的快速实施，并降低许多系统中碳储存的持久性。 与此同时，研究发现，若干自然碳储量措施可增强群落对入侵的抵抗力/韧性，特别是在森林中，从而抑制入侵物种在这些系统中的扩散。 这些动态表明，NCS 与入侵之间存在正反馈循环：NCS 有助于控制入侵，而成功的入侵控制反过来又促进了 NCS 的进一步实施。只要 NCS 项目获得用于持续管理入侵物种的资源，这种反馈就能加速陆地碳储量的增长，并为生物多样性带来协同效益。 我们重点指出了需要进一步研究的领域，包括如何利用气候行动的金融机制来克服入侵物种引发的实施障碍。

items.title: National-scale PM2.5 health consequences of a proposed LNG power project in South Korea: looking beyond localized assessment boundaries
items.title_en: National-scale PM2.5 health consequences of a proposed LNG power project in South Korea: looking beyond localized assessment boundaries
items.title_zh: 韩国某拟建液化天然气发电项目对全国范围PM2.5健康影响的研究：超越局部评估范围
items.summary_en: Environmental impact assessments (EIAs) in South Korea rely heavily on localized dispersion models within restricted geographical boundaries (∼10 km), failing to capture regional secondary PM2.5 formation and broad population exposure. To address these limitations, this study pursues two distinct objectives: (1) evaluating systemic deficiencies in the current EIA framework, and (2) quantifying the nationwide health impacts and monetized mortality damages of a proposed 3 GW liquefied natural gas power cluster at the Yongin Semiconductor Industrial Complex. We employed Global InMAP—selected specifically for its ability to simulate long-range atmospheric transport and secondary PM2.5 chemistry across national scales where local models fail—under 35%, 55%, and 75% capacity factor (CF) scenarios. Health outcomes were modeled nationwide and monetized using domestic and international Values of a Statistical Life. Regarding health impact quantification, the proposed cluster is projected to cause 21.5–31.1 additional annual premature deaths nationwide, with secondary PM2.5 driving 63%–71% of this burden. Under the central 55% CF scenario, annual monetized mortality damages range from 34.4 billion KRW (∼USD 23 million; domestic benchmark) to 195.9–295.5 billion KRW (∼USD 143–201 million; international benchmarks). Regarding EIA framework evaluation, spatial disaggregation revealed critical regulatory blind spots: only 14%–16% of attributable premature deaths occur within the typical 10 km EIA assessment radius, while 67%–69% fall outside Yongin City and 46%–47% outside host Gyeonggi Province. Geographically bounded EIAs omit the vast majority of health externalities; regulatory frameworks must integrate regional secondary PM2.5 modeling and transparently monetize health damages in energy planning decisions.
items.summary_zh: 韩国的环境影响评估（EIA）主要依赖于限定地理范围（约10公里）内的局部扩散模型，未能全面反映区域性PM2.5的二次生成及广泛人群的暴露情况。 为解决这些局限性，本研究旨在实现两个明确目标：（1）评估当前EIA框架中的系统性缺陷；（2）量化拟建于龙仁半导体工业园区的3吉瓦液化天然气发电集群对全国范围内的健康影响及可量化的死亡损害。 我们采用了Global InMAP模型——该模型因其能够模拟跨国家尺度的长距离大气传输和二次PM2.5化学反应（而局部模型在此方面存在局限）而被专门选中——并在35%、55%和75%的容量因子（CF）情景下进行了模拟。 健康影响在全国范围内进行了建模，并采用国内和国际的“统计生命价值”标准进行了货币化评估。就健康影响量化而言，预计该拟建集群将在全国范围内每年导致21.5–31.1例额外过早死亡，其中二次PM2.5导致了63%–71%的死亡负担。 在55%容量因子的中心情景下，年度货币化死亡损害范围为344亿韩元（约合2300万美元；国内基准）至1959亿–2955亿韩元（约合1.43–2.01亿美元；国际基准）。 关于环境影响评估（EIA）框架的评估，空间细分揭示了关键的监管盲点：仅有14%–16%的可归因过早死亡发生在典型的10公里EIA评估半径范围内，而67%–69%发生在龙仁市以外，46%–47%发生在项目所在地京畿道以外。 受地理边界限制的环境影响评估忽略了绝大多数健康外部性；监管框架必须整合区域性PM2.5二次沉降模型，并在能源规划决策中以透明的方式对健康损害进行货币化评估。

items.title: Detecting acceleration in global mean temperature using supralinear trends
items.title_en: Detecting acceleration in global mean temperature using supralinear trends
items.title_zh: 利用超线性趋势检测全球平均气温的加速上升趋势
items.summary_en: Whether global mean surface temperature has accelerated has received opposite answers in quick succession, reported as undetectable on data to 2023 and as significant on data to 2024. This raises two questions: since when is acceleration detectable, and how far does the answer depend on the test used? We show that structural-break tests, often used for this purpose, cannot reliably date the onset of a continuously accelerating warming rate. We therefore test for curvature directly, under specifications whose null is exactly a constant warming rate and whose alternative is curvature rather than a break. One is a linearithmic trend, which grows faster than linear but more slowly than any polynomial of degree greater than one; the other estimates the curvature freely from the data. We report alongside them the quadratic trend used in the recent literature. Over 1970–2025, in a single full-sample test, the linearithmic and quadratic coefficients are positive and statistically significant in all five major temperature datasets once El Niño and solar variability are controlled for. The onset of acceleration is dated by re-estimating over expanding windows and correcting for multiple testing. Under the linearithmic specification, acceleration first becomes detectable in windows ending in mid-2023 for NOAA, late 2023 for GISTEMP and mid-2024 for ERA5, and not yet in HadCRUT or Berkeley. The free-curvature specification agrees on direction but rejects in fewer datasets, since estimating the shape costs precision. The linearithmic specification implies the least curvature of the three, with an acceleration that declines over time, and so the lowest warming of the three when extended to 2050.
items.summary_zh: 关于全球平均地表温度是否呈现加速趋势，近期接连出现了截然相反的结论：基于截至2023年的数据，该现象被认定为无法检测；而基于截至2024年的数据，则被认定为显著存在。这引发了两个问题：从何时起可以检测到这种加速趋势？答案在多大程度上取决于所采用的检验方法？ 我们证明，常用于此目的的结构断点检验无法可靠地确定持续加速变暖率的起始时间。因此，我们在特定假设下直接检验曲率——其原假设恰为恒定变暖率，而备择假设是曲率而非断点。 其中一种是线性对数趋势，其增长速度快于线性趋势，但慢于任何次数大于一的多项式；另一种则从数据中自由估计曲率。我们同时报告了近期文献中使用的二次趋势。 在1970–2025年期间，通过单次全样本检验，在控制了厄尔尼诺现象和太阳活动变异性后，线性对数趋势和二次趋势的系数在所有五个主要温度数据集中均为正值且在统计上显著。通过在扩展时间窗口内重新估计并进行多重检验校正，确定了变暖加速的起始时间。 在线性对数模型下，加速趋势最早可在以下时间段结束的窗口中检测到：NOAA数据集为2023年年中，GISTEMP数据集为2023年底，ERA5数据集为2024年年中，而HadCRUT和伯克利数据集目前尚未检测到。 自由曲率模型在趋势方向上与线性对数模型一致，但因估计形状会牺牲精度，因此被更多数据集所拒绝。线性对数模型在三种模型中暗示的曲率最小，其加速趋势随时间减弱，因此当预测延伸至2050年时，该模型显示的变暖幅度在三种模型中最低。

items.title: Trends and drivers of recent oxygenation in the Indian sector of the Southern Ocean
items.title_en: Trends and drivers of recent oxygenation in the Indian sector of the Southern Ocean

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 29 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01963-zThe Sustainable Development Goals aim to improve lives, but it is unclear whether progress on Sustainable Development Goal indicators translates into greater subjective well-being over time. A study of 42 countries found associations in levels, but weak links with year-to-year changes in life evaluations.

items.title: Record-breaking high tides spark chaos – and kayak commutes – across California
items.title_en: Record-breaking high tides spark chaos – and kayak commutes – across California
items.title_zh: 创纪录的高潮引发了加利福尼亚州各地的混乱——同时也催生了皮划艇通勤现象
items.summary_en: Seawater surges into low-lying communities from San Diego to San Francisco Bay Area, submerging streets, homes and businessesHistoric high tides have caused chaos up and down the California coast this week, as parts of the state were inundated by record-breaking water levels. Seawater surged into low-lying communities from San Diego to the San Francisco Bay Area, submerging streets, flooding homes and businesses, and jamming important transportation corridors and train routes.Kayakers and paddleboarders could be seen gliding through typically busy thoroughfares in Marin county, north of San Francisco, on Monday and Tuesday. Several drivers had to be rescued from floating cars in the area, while cyclists who had attempted to cross the temporary lagoon that had formed quickly found themselves waist-deep. Further south, in cities such as Newport Beach, water pounded the emergency infrastructure set up to keep out the swelling sea, which seeped through berms, seawalls and sandbag blockades along the shoreline. Continue reading...
items.summary_zh: 从圣地亚哥到旧金山湾区的低洼社区均遭遇海水倒灌，街道、民宅和商铺被淹。本周，创纪录的高潮位给加利福尼亚州沿岸各地带来了混乱，该州部分地区被破纪录的水位淹没。 从圣地亚哥到旧金山湾区的低洼社区均遭海水涌入，街道被淹，民宅和商铺进水，重要交通干道和铁路线路也因此瘫痪。周一和周二，在旧金山以北的马林县，人们可以看到皮划艇和立式桨板爱好者穿梭于平日里车水马龙的干道上。 该地区有多名司机被从漂浮的汽车中救出，而试图穿越临时形成的泻湖的骑行者很快发现自己已深陷齐腰深的水中。 再往南，在新港滩等城市，汹涌的洪水猛烈冲击着为阻挡不断上涨的海水而搭建的应急设施，海水从海岸线沿线的土堤、海堤和沙袋屏障中渗入。继续阅读...

items.title_zh: 特朗普表示，政府将“废除”拜登时期的甲烷排放规定
items.summary_en: Critics warn of climate danger as president in Texas claims change will save companies and consumers billionsDonald Trump said his administration was “terminating” Biden-era regulations holding oil and gas companies accountable for large leaks of planet-warming methane during a rally in Lubbock, Texas, on Tuesday evening.“Tonight, I’m officially terminating Biden’s expensive and unnecessary methane regulations to save consumers and energy producers,” Trump said, lifting what he called “crippling regulations on methane that caused prices to skyrocket” for small oil and gas operators. items.summary_zh: 批评人士警告气候风险，而身在得克萨斯州的总统则声称，政策调整将为企业与消费者节省数十亿美元。周二晚间，唐纳德·特朗普在得克萨斯州拉伯克市的一场集会上表示，其政府将“废除”拜登时期的法规——该法规要求石油和天然气公司对导致全球变暖的甲烷大规模泄漏承担责任。““今晚，我将正式废除拜登那些昂贵且不必要的甲烷法规，以拯救消费者和能源生产商，”特朗普说道，并称此举将解除他所称的“导致价格飙升的、对小型油气运营商具有瘫痪性影响的甲烷法规”。 他表示，此项调整将为消费者和能源生产商节省450亿美元，并释放2.1亿桶石油，这相当于美国约10天的石油消耗量。继续阅读...

items.summary_en: A solar eclipse recorded more than 2,700 years ago is revealing surprising secrets about Earth's rotation and the Sun's ancient behavior. By correcting an eight-kilometer error in the location of an ancient Chinese capital, scientists were able to reconstruct a total solar eclipse that occurred in 709 BCE and obtain more accurate measurements of how fast Earth was spinning at the time.

items.title: Earth's ice ages may have been driven by a hidden ocean chain reaction
items.title_en: Earth's ice ages may have been driven by a hidden ocean chain reaction
items.title_zh: 地球的冰河时代可能是由一种隐蔽的海洋连锁反应驱动的
items.summary_en: Scientists have uncovered a surprising connection between Earth's opposite poles that may help explain how the planet plunged into past ice ages. New research suggests that as massive ice sheets expanded across the Northern Hemisphere, they cooled Atlantic Ocean waters that eventually traveled south toward Antarctica. This cooling may have disrupted Southern Ocean circulation, allowing the ocean to absorb and store more carbon dioxide from the atmosphere, further cooling the planet.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们发现地球两极之间存在一种令人惊讶的联系，这或许有助于解释地球过去是如何陷入冰河时代的。 最新研究表明，当巨大的冰盖在北半球扩张时，它们冷却了大西洋的水体，这些水体最终向南流向南极洲。这种降温可能扰乱了南大洋的环流，使海洋能够吸收并储存更多来自大气中的二氧化碳，从而进一步冷却地球。

items.title_zh: 南极洲的“末日冰川”可能导致海平面上升幅度达到此前预测值的两倍
items.summary_en: Antarctica’s Thwaites Glacier may be melting twice as much as previously predicted, even without additional global warming. Scientists discovered that warm ocean water is penetrating miles beneath the ice, weakening its foundations and accelerating its retreat. A new model predicts that the glacier could add up to 30 millimeters to global sea levels by 2100, with a 60% chance of losing a crucial stabilizing ridge.
items.summary_zh: 南极洲的斯威茨冰川的融化速度可能达到此前预测值的两倍，即使全球变暖不再加剧也是如此。科学家发现，温暖的海水正渗透到冰层下方数英里处，削弱了冰川的基础，并加速了其后退。 一项新模型预测，到2100年，该冰川可能导致全球海平面上升多达30毫米，且有60%的概率会失去一条至关重要的稳定山脊。
